caseTitle: A case of major depressive disorder, recurrent, severe, without psychotic features
objectives: To present a case of recurrent major depressive disorder in a young mother
To discuss the role of psychosocial stressors in relapse
cc: I can't sleep and I feel like everything is falling apart
premorbid: Described as quiet, responsible, and a perfectionist; few close friends; coped with stress by praying and working longer hours.
hpi:
Two months prior to admission, the patient lost her job after the company downsized.
She began sleeping 3 to 4 hours a night with early waking, lost interest in caring for her children, and cried daily.
One week prior to admission she voiced passive death wishes, prompting her husband to bring her for consult.
famhx: Paternal grandfather died by suicide; sister treated for depression.

family.name: Ramon
family.desc: A retired jeepney driver who drinks daily; separated from the mother since the patient was 10.

family.name: Lourdes
family.desc: A sari-sari store owner; close to the patient.

anaInfancy: Born full term via NSVD at a lying-in clinic; no reported delays in milestones.
anaChild: An above-average student; quiet, with few friends. Parents separated when she was 10.
anaAdol: Became the caretaker of her younger sister; graduated high school with honors.
anaAdult: Finished a 2-year course; worked in a call center for 8 years; married at 25.
living: Lives with her husband and children in a rented room; income now relies on the husband.
rosMed: No fever, weight loss, headache, palpitations, or bowel changes.
peGen: Conscious, coherent, not in distress. Unremarkable chest, heart, and abdominal findings.
neuro: Cranial nerves intact; motor 5/5 in all extremities; no EPS.
appNarr: Wearing a hospital gown; psychomotor slowing.
admitImp: Major depressive disorder, recurrent, severe, without psychotic features
course:
HD0: Admitted; started on sertraline 50 mg daily; placed on suicide precautions.
HD3: Sleep improved to 5 hours; still tearful.
HD7: Mood brighter; denies death wishes; sertraline increased to 100 mg.

labPanels.ua: Yellow, slightly hazy, pH 6.5, SG 1.015, (-) sugar, (-) albumin

positives: 2 months of low mood, anhedonia, insomnia
Family history of depression and suicide
ddx: Recurrent; full depressive syndrome for 2 months
Bipolar II disorder, current episode depressed
primaryDx: Major depressive disorder, recurrent, severe, without psychotic features
otherDx: Alcohol use, not meeting criteria for a disorder

bps.Predisposing|Biological: Family history of depression and suicide

integrated: A 34-year-old woman with genetic loading and perfectionistic traits developed a recurrent depressive episode after job loss, maintained by insomnia and financial strain.
prognosis: Good: supportive family, good premorbid functioning, insight. Poor: recurrence, family history, ongoing financial stress.
furtherPlans:
Family meeting with husband before discharge.
Refer to social service for livelihood assistance.
discussion: Recurrent depression after a psychosocial stressor is common; continuation treatment for at least 6 to 12 months after remission reduces relapse.
safetyPlan: Husband to keep medications; return if suicidal thoughts recur.
